profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: I’m always creating—whether it’s tackling complex engineering challenges at work or diving into new projects never losing sight of what interested me in software engineering. My teammates rely on me for thoughtful insights and quick, informed decision-making. I move across different sectors with a mix of creativity, technical expertise, and problem-solving. From setting up and optimizing microservices to working with AI and latest technical innovation, I focus on pushing boundaries and driving progress, I enjoy setting the pace.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mar. 2022 – present 
Optimized microservices with reactive programming for non-blocking concurrency, boosting responsiveness and throughput. Designed thread management solutions to efficiently handle high concurrency and minimize latency.


Enhanced MongoDB performance using the aggregation framework, compound indexing, and explain plans for query optimization and faster data retrieval.

Designed scalable microservices using Kafka for messaging and Kubernetes/Docker for containerization and orchestration, ensuring system modularity and seamless deployment.

Advocated for TDD practices, ensuring well-tested, zero-downtime services. Led performance testing with tools like JMeter and AppDynamics, addressing issues to significantly improve system throughput.
Led agile sprints and releases  requiring cross-team collaboration to balance complex procedures and meet deadlines, driving continuous progress through product demos and user story execution..


Personal Projects (2025)

Developed a performance testing tool using Go, integrating streaming, profiling, and concurrent execution for scalable testing deployed and managed with Docker/Kubernetes 
Built a Swift application using NoSQL, SQL, Python, Stripe, and React, improving customer checkout experience with seamless payment integration.

websites 
• Tested legitimacy of websites and virus potential with built software 
• Kept integrity of the companies trusted service by maintaining online customer
inquiries

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Addressing the crisis of recycling especially with the recent shutdown of the SC center no longer taking recycling products from UCSC. Our team aims to bridge the gap of recyclable and pre-cycling knowledge while having fun. Using Unity and C# were working on interactive ways and mechanics to help the cause. Our app is going to be used at the Santa Cruz Recycling Center and available on both the Android and Apple store.

positions.title: Co-Founder and Software Engineer
positions.description: Podium is an exchange of services application aimed to connect students. As the programmer responsible for creating both apps in entirety i'm setting the bar high. I aim to use swift and android along with my development experience to create a interactive app with a greater user experience. Podium is currently in development for multiple platforms.

positions.title: Project Owner
positions.description: Created an application that would allow users that owned a google home speaker to connect and have an engaging conversation about the NBA backed by a machine learning software. Technology used included google action and cloud functions, firebase for database and hosting, and lastly Python / JS for the frontend.

positions.title: Java Instructor
positions.description: Taught two week sessions at a time a semesters worth of java with different students each session. Responsible for developing and implementing an entire Curriculum. Created and overseen 28 unique projects ranging from game development, graphical interfaces, and programs dealing with advanced data structures.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
Data Structures and Algorithms/Java
While attending...Interim teacher during the lab portion of the course. Analyzed and deduced complex algorithms with detail and precision. Helped students with any code related questions, and even explained key concepts from scratch as needed.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Java/C++/Python/Data Structures/Raspberry Pi
Hand selected by the Chair of the Department to be the first ever CIS tutor at the school. Worked with all types of students, from experts to novices. Inspired and challenged them to define and solve problems in their own terms. Also explained most core concepts in the programming languages listed above.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
I find connecting with people very enjoyable and I have a thirst for knowledge therefore I do really well in Sales.
During this time period I was awarded:

 2013 Employee of the year.
 2014 Top Sales TNF competition in whole district.
 2015 Top Gun  during multiple pay periods.

volunteerExperiences.description:
If I could use one word to describe my volunteer experience its rewarding.

I received the opportunity to work with people returning or brand new to education. Most of them were very discouraged, I was lucky enough to be one of the first people they were introduced too on their path in higher education. I not only guided them, but encouraged them that they were in arms reach of their dreams. This was one of my favorite jobs of all time.
